Miami's safety is doubtful, and several Jets receivers and linemen are out.

On offense, NYJ posts 0.05 [dc19] EPA per pass play but -0.04 [dc21] per run play, so the Jets can attack soft pass coverage on early downs while keeping the run game on schedule.

sections.heading: Special teams
sections.body: Miami has made 72.7% [kc1] of its field goals on 22 [kc2] attempts and 71.4% [kc3] of its long-range tries on 7 [kc4] attempts, so the leg is dependable but the sample is thin. The kicker position has changed: Patterson made 7 [kc5] field goals, Gonzalez made 6 [kc7] after him, and Carlson has made 3 [kc9] since arriving, so treat him as unproven. Punts net 39.1 [kc11] yards on 34 [kc12] punts, with 29.4% [kc13] pinned deep. Kickoffs produce touchbacks on 35.0% [kc15] of 40 [kc16] kickoffs, while Miami's return unit averages 26.1 [kc17] yards on 49 [kc18] returns, so kicking deep takes away a real return threat. Miami's special-teams EPA is -0.12 [kc19] per play over 241 [kc20] plays, against 0.01 [kc21] over 288 [kc22] plays for NYJ. Kick deep to the returners, and don't assume Miami's long kicks are automatic late.

sections.heading: Injuries and availability
sections.body: For Miami, WR Jared Wayne is Out, a minor passing-game loss. S Dante Trader Jr. is Doubtful with a shoulder injury; he has averaged 85.2% [ic3] of snaps over 9 [ic4] games, so losing him thins the back end. C Aaron Brewer is Questionable with a concussion but has played 100.0% [ic6] of snaps over 9 [ic7] games, so his absence would be a real change up front. For the Jets, WRs Isaiah Williams and Omar Cooper Jr. are Out, and Cooper draws 7.5% [ic10] of targets. DT David Onyemata is Out; his 46.0% [ic12] snap share comes from just 2 [ic13] games. DT Harrison Phillips is Questionable and averages 54.6% [ic15] of snaps over 11 [ic16] games. G Dylan Parham is Questionable with a knee injury but has full practice participation.

sections.heading: Key matchups
sections.body: Four matchups will decide this game. First, Miami's early-down passing against the Jets' rush: Miami throws on 52.8% [mc1] of early-down plays over 417 [mc2] plays, and its sack rate of 8.8% [mc3] meets a Jets pressure proxy of 15.8% [mc4]. Expect quick drops and screens, which Miami uses on 8.2% [mc6] of dropbacks, so keep edges disciplined. Second, the Jets' right-side run game against Miami's box: NYJ ranks 11th [mc7] in right-side run rate, and Miami allows explosive runs on 10.6% [mc8] of carries with 6.6 [mc9] defenders in the box. Run right when the numbers favor NYJ. Third, the Jets' passing game against Miami's back end: Miami allows 0.14 [mc12] EPA per pass play over 320 [mc13] plays, and opponents convert 47.5% [mc14] on third down. Safety Dante Trader Jr. is Doubtful after playing 85.2% [mc17] of snaps over 9 [mc18] games, so attack the middle of the field when he is out. Fourth, field position: Miami's special-teams EPA is -0.12 [mc19] per play against 0.01 [mc20] for NYJ, and its kick returners average 26.1 [mc21] yards. Pin Miami deep and win the hidden-yardage battle.
